## ROLEPLAY RULE 5. Don't use information gained outside of in-character means.
You are not allowed to use out of game methods to communicate with other players connected to the same server, or use LOOC or OOC channels to share current round information with them. This is referred to as "metacomming" and includes any outer means of communication such as text, voice, images or video. If you’re watching a public livestream don’t connect to the current round or later use that information as an advantage.
Local out of character (LOOC), and out of character (OOC) is used for communication outside roleplay and should never be used to give you or another player advantages over others. An acceptable use would be to teach another player game mechanics, despite advantages.
